title: Your matters
soon: Soon you'll handle matters from this category here.

descriptions.security: Blocking your ID card and PESEL number, lost documents, suspicious messages.
descriptions.vehicles: Your cars, OC insurance, technical inspection, buying and selling.
descriptions.taxes: Letters from the tax office, PIT returns, property tax.
descriptions.zus: Contributions, pension, sick leave, visiting ZUS.
descriptions.travel: Trips abroad, train and city transport tickets, and safe coach travel.
descriptions.licences: Driving licence, penalty points and other licences.
descriptions.business: Your own business: registering, changes, suspending.
descriptions.payments: Official fees, fines and local taxes in one place.
descriptions.family: Children, 800+, the Large Family Card, civil records.
descriptions.elections: Where you vote, changing your polling place, dates.
descriptions.other: Everything else: registering your address, passport, certificates.

matters.title: What you can do
matters.soon: You can't do this in the prototype yet. We're working on it.

descriptions.blockPesel: A restricted PESEL makes it harder to take out a loan in your name. You can lift it whenever you want.
descriptions.blockDocument: Lost your ID or had it stolen? Report it right away so nobody can use it.
descriptions.safeOnline: How to spot a fake text, email or website, and what to do if something goes wrong.
descriptions.checkId: Check that an ID card is valid and not reported, e.g. before signing a contract.
descriptions.checkPesel: See whether your PESEL is restricted right now.
descriptions.defenceTraining: Sign up for free training, e.g. in first aid or what to do in an emergency.
descriptions.safetyGuide: What to do in an emergency: alarms, evacuation, a first-aid kit and a family plan.
descriptions.collision: Fill in a minor-collision statement on your phone with the other driver, without a paper form.
descriptions.checkInsurance: Check if a car has valid third-party insurance (OC), e.g. before buying it or after a collision.
descriptions.penaltyPoints: See how many penalty points you have and when they stop counting.
descriptions.driverLicence: See which driving licence categories you have and until when they are valid.
descriptions.vehicleHistory: Before buying a car, check its mileage, technical inspections and number of owners.
descriptions.fines: See your traffic fines and pay them in one place.
descriptions.travelAbroad: Register your trip before going abroad. If something happens, the consul can find and help you faster.
descriptions.safeBus: Before a trip, check that the coach has a valid technical inspection and insurance (OC).
descriptions.trainTickets: Buy train tickets from different carriers in one place.
descriptions.cityCard: Top up a ticket on the Małopolska Agglomeration Card (MKA), e.g. for trams and buses in Kraków.
descriptions.cityTicket: Buy a bus and tram ticket in your city, without a separate operator app.
descriptions.contributions: See which social insurance contributions your employer pays for you and whether they all reached ZUS.
descriptions.pension: Check how much you already have in your ZUS account and what your pension may be.
descriptions.sickLeave: See your sick notes from the doctor: from when, until when, and whether your employer got them.
descriptions.familyBenefit: Apply for the 800 plus benefit for your child and check when the money will arrive.
descriptions.zusVisit: Book a visit at a ZUS office or a video call with an officer.
